gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-hebrew: Round, loud and unshaded. Noto Serif Hebrew takes over from there, with a tall sturdy body and strokes that shift just enough to notice, while Autour One does its best work at display size.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-kannada: Traditional in its bones, Noto Serif Kannada brings big counters and a moderate thick-thin ratio. Autour One sits above it as a rounded, nib-like line with no swelling at the ends, and the two feel like a shout followed by a murmur.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-khojki: Bold, round and unfussy up top. And Noto Serif Khojki, with short ascenders over big bowls, gives Autour One its best foil, since big and short is where that heading earns its keep.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-lao: Autour One draws a thread of ink with no swelling or tapering, a bold round look. Noto Serif Lao has bowls with gentle weight shifts, and that gap between the two is the pair's whole charm.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-makasar: Autour One keeps its horizontals as thick as its verticals, which gives the heading a blunt, confident face. Yet Noto Serif Makasar does the quieter job better, with a tall x-height and a soft step from heavy to light.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-malayala: Big open counters fill every small letter of Noto Serif Malayalam, with bowls that thin gently. Autour One adds a bold heading with no brush-like swell anywhere, so the page gets one smooth voice and one moderately contrasted one.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-np-hmong: Smooth outlines, bold and unshaded. Noto Serif NP Hmong follows with a faint charcoal-like shadow and lowercase that rises near cap height, so a long read stays lively against Autour One.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-old-uygh: Autour One is bold and round, with letters that never thicken or thin. Noto Serif Old Uyghur brings tall bowls like blown glass bulbs and a barely pressed brush swell, and that restraint is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-oriya: Noto Serif Oriya reads dignified, its curves a little heavier than its joins and its lowercase close to cap height. And Autour One, with diagonals as thick as its uprights, earns its keep when it runs big and short.
